paper.title: Trained Ternary Quantization
paper.read_scope: method sections 4.1-4.2, equations 6-9 and experiment result tables; gains are model-dependent, not evidence for HSI

author_code.officiality: Zhu author repository; README identifies the paper and TensorFlow/tensorpack implementation
author_code.license: root Apache-2.0 with Yuxin Wu attribution; example trainer also credits Yuxin Wu; no claim that this check licenses every nested dependency

adaptation.type: independent PyTorch CPU implementation of explicit TTQ-style weight simulation and a new canonical 2-bit weight-only codec
adaptation.forward: strict w > t*maxabs or w < -t*maxabs; equality maps to zero per paper equation6
adaptation.gradient: scaled latent STE; negative magnitude derivative uses minus sum on negative mask, from the signed forward chain rule and author sign multiplication; paper equation7 prints a sum without this explicit minus
adaptation.difference: author mask uses strict interior-zero condition, giving a different exact-threshold boundary; ours follows equation6 and tests exact ties
adaptation.initialization: project choice: sign-group mean magnitudes, empty-sign fallback maxabs, all-zero fallback1; no source weight normalization or training recipe copied
adaptation.scale_constraint: finite positive direct parameters; invalid optimizer result rejected, no hidden projection
adaptation.storage: 2-bit codes plus explicit shape/scales/header/padding; weight-only, bias and model not included
adaptation.execution: FP32 activation and dense arithmetic after decoding; no low-bit GPU kernel or skipped zero computation

reuse: published math and existing installed PyTorch/NumPy public APIs; no TensorFlow code copied, framework monkeypatching, CIFAR labels, training schedule, or new dependency
limits: CPU local engineering only; full-model integration, actual matched multiseed/class protection and deployment speed remain untested
